notes: The 90 choices cover 30 meanings; three pairs per meaning share a winner and are correlated.
CLIP image and text encoders, preprocessing, semantic scoring and MLP ranking were run. Search provider retrieval and Gemini were not called.
This test set was inspected after its initial evaluation; subsequent runs were implementation regression checks, not a fresh benchmark.
Node uses native CPU inference and Sharp resizing. Physical phone performance was not measured.
